{{Top|leg}}
'''''Adumar: Five Years of Union''''' was an award-winning [[holodocumentary]] produced by [[Hallis Saper]] in [[18 ABY/Legends|18 ABY]]. ''Adumar: Five Years of Union'' offered a perspective on the planet [[Adumar/Legends|Adumar]] five years after its political unification and admission into the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. It featured interviews with [[General/Legends|General]] [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]], [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Tycho Celchu/Legends|Tycho Celchu]], and [[Major/Legends|Majors]] [[Derek Klivian/Legends|Derek Klivian]] and [[Wes Janson/Legends|Wes Janson]]&mdash;the New Republic's diplomatic team and major figures in the war of union.
